scores.rationale: The deliverable presents the full pipeline in the exact required order—validation, transliteration table before NFKD, NFKD plus U+0300–U+036F mark removal, apostrophe deletion, lowercasing, word splitting on [a-z0-9] runs, separator joining, and word-boundary-aware maxLength truncation—with clear re

All required edge cases are explicitly documented with concrete examples: empty/whitespace/punctuation-only input, leading/trailing/repeated separators, ß and the full transliteration table, compatibility characters (ligatures, roman numerals, circled digits), non-latin scripts, apostrophes, first-w
